visual_summary: A page of slanted panels shows a transition from open space combat to an interior, organic-mechanical environment. On the left, ships and debris explode in space. In the central and right panels, a small human figure identified by the narration as Aghora moves at extreme speed through a dense maze of tube-like, fleshy-metal structures while rounded, jellyfish-like beings drift nearby. The captions explain that she bypassed the enemy's defenses by using invisibility and mirror-like logic, then traveled to the far reaches of the universe to strike at the controlling force instead of fighting the creatures directly.
